title: OVSBM Design
outcome: A studio brand credible enough to send without explanation
summary: My own studio brand, rebuilt as I moved from a student portfolio to running a business with real clients.

sections.head: Outgrowing your own brand
sections.body: My original portfolio was built when I was finishing my diploma. It did its job at the time, but once I was running OVSBM Design as a proper business with real clients and retainers, it had stopped representing what I actually do.

sections.head: A brand that works as hard as the work itself
sections.body: Something minimal and credible enough to send a client without any explanation. Strip the portfolio back to what matters, be more intentional with the copy, and give the identity a clear point of view without overdoing it.

sections.head: A cleaner, more confident presence
sections.body: The site is quieter, more focused, and a better reflection of how I approach the work. It keeps evolving as the business does, and this site, oscarshand.com, is the latest rebuild.
